# Orvio 0.27

- Subtitles on phones: choosing a subtitle track (or Off) in Audio & subtitles now takes effect and the checkmark follows your choice. Tracks with the same language are numbered, so two "English" tracks can be told apart.
- Subtitles on TV: press down during a film or episode to jump straight to the subtitles button, then OK.
- Several playlists now form one library. Every playlist you add is merged automatically: categories with the same name come together and a film, series or channel that more than one playlist carries shows once. There is nothing to switch any more.
- New Settings: grouped pages with icons and live summaries (playlists and titles, subtitle language, logo style, sound, version), and every page opens with its own header.
- Playlists page: your whole library at a glance, each playlist with what it adds, Add a playlist, refresh frequency and Update now for all playlists at once.
- Editing a playlist: Refresh playlist and Remove playlist sit at the top (reachable by TV remote); removing one keeps your other playlists.
- Restyled Playback, Appearance, Sound, Downloads, Profiles, App updates, Account and About pages.
